_about: 20 Texas fishing places for v1. Lake coordinates = USGS NWIS lake gauge site (public domain), via waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/site, siteType=LK, read 2026-11-23. Coast coordinates = NOAA CO-OPS tide prediction station (mdapi stations.json?type=tidepredictions, read 2026-11-23). Lake species/ratings/tips come from the TPWD lake page (tpwd_slug), collected by coleta.py.
